name: isDosProtectionPolicyConfigured
definition: An enabled DoS Protection rule with action protect and a bound aggregate or classified DoS profile applies to all traffic (every zone, source, destination, user and service is any), and no earlier all-traffic rule allows traffic without protection. A protect rule limited to some zones or addresses is Not evaluated (its scope cannot be judged).
population: DoS protection rules of the vsys read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A DoS rulebase read showing an enabled rule with action protect and a bound aggregate or classified DoS profile that applies to all traffic (every zone, source, destination, user and service is any), with no earlier all-traffic allow rule. A protect rule limited to some zones, sources, destinations, users or services is Not evaluated, because zone names are arbitrary and its scope cannot be judged.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: rulebase/dos/rules/entry: action (deny, allow, protect), from, to, source, destination, source-user, service, negate-source/negate-destination and protection/(aggregate|classified)/profile names are from the CLI hierarchy. A rule counts as all-traffic only when from, to, source and destination are listed as any (and source-user and service are any or not listed) and is not negated. Three answers: True for an all-traffic protect rule with a bound profile and no all-traffic allow rule ahead of it; False when no enabled protect rule with a bound profile is among the rules read, or when an all-traffic allow rule comes before any protect rule; Not evaluated when the only protect rules are limited to some zones, sources, destinations, users or services, because PAN-OS zone names are arbitrary and the key cannot tell which zone faces the internet (never False for a scoped rule). A successful reply with no DoS rules, an empty result or an empty rules element is Not evaluated: it is also what a firewall managed from a central manager, another virtual system or a role without access returns. vsys1 only.
